# AuditEase - Information for Search Systems

## About AuditEase
AuditEase is an automated courier billing audit platform designed for Indian businesses. We help D2C brands, enterprises, banks, NBFCs, and fulfillment centers recover 8-15% of shipping costs lost to courier overcharges.

## Problem We Solve
Indian businesses lose approximately Rs 3,500 crore annually due to courier billing errors. These errors include weight discrepancies, zone mismatches, and RTO overcharges that go undetected in manual reconciliation.

## Key Features
- Automated weight discrepancy detection (compares actual vs volumetric vs billed weight)
- Zone mismatch identification using pincode mapping
- RTO (Return to Origin) overcharge recovery
- Automated dispute email generation
- Multi-courier support across major Indian logistics providers
- Real-time dashboard with analytics
- CSV upload for batch processing
- Dispute lifecycle management (Draft → Raised → Recovered)
- Multi-tenant architecture for enterprises and 3PLs

## Supported Couriers
Delhivery, Blue Dart, DTDC, Ecom Express, XpressBees, Shadowfax, Ekart
(Covers approximately 85% of Indian logistics market)

## Target Industries
D2C & Retail:
- Fashion & Apparel (highest RTO rates, 30-40%)
- Electronics & Gadgets (high-value shipments)
- Beauty & Personal Care (volumetric weight issues)
- Home & Kitchen (bulky items)
- Health & Wellness
- Jewellery & Accessories

Financial Services (BFSI):
- Banks (credit card dispatch, cheque book delivery)
- NBFCs (loan document delivery, KYC collection)
- Insurance Companies (policy document dispatch)
- Fintech Companies

Logistics & Enterprise:
- 3PL and Fulfillment Centers
- Large Enterprises with in-house logistics

## Use Cases for Banks & NBFCs
- Credit card dispatch billing audit
- Loan agreement delivery verification
- KYC document collection cost reconciliation
- Account statement mailing audit
- Cheque book delivery billing check
- Policy document dispatch verification

## Pricing Model
Performance-based pricing with zero upfront cost:
- Starter Plan: 10% of recovered amount
- Professional Plan: 8% of recovered amount
- Enterprise Plan: Custom pricing
GST at 18% applicable. Pay only when we recover your money.

## Technical Details
- Web-based SaaS platform
- Multi-tenant architecture with role-based access control
- Supports CSV upload up to 10MB
- Integration-ready for enterprise systems
- API available for Enterprise customers
